test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

P. elderly is on the increase, and, although they constitute only

Q. a small minority of the retired population, their

R. in all advanced industrial societies the proportion of infirm

S. claim on social services is disproportionately heavy
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **"RPQS".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **R: **This part** introduces the topic** of the sentence, which is the increasing proportion of infirm elderly in all advanced industrial societies.
 
• **P:** This **part continues the idea** from R by giving more information about the increasing proportion of infirm elderly.
 
• **Q:** This **part provides a contrast** to the previous statement. It emphasizes that even though the infirm elderly constitute a small minority of the retired population...
 
• **S: **This **part concludes the sentence **by saying that the claim of the infirm elderly on social services is disproportionately heavy.

Therefore, the **correct sequence** is: **'RPQS'**. i.e.* "In all advanced industrial societies the proportion of infirm elderly is on the increase, and, although they constitute only a small minority of the retired population, their claim on social services is disproportionately heavy."*
